title: Cabbage Spirit Over Misty Lake
description: A giant smiling cabbage spirit with a leafy green head and pale body floats in the cloudy night sky above a misty Chinese mountain lake. In the foreground, a small boat with a sail and two figures drifts on the water near a stone fortress, surrounded by swirling colorful nebula clouds, a glowing yellow moon with a pagoda silhouette, and floating lanterns.
prompt: A giant smiling anthropomorphic cabbage spirit with leafy green hair and pale green body floats joyfully in the night sky with arms raised, above a traditional Chinese misty mountain lake. A small wooden boat with sail and two people rows on the water, a stone fortress sits on a rocky cliff to the right, a glowing yellow moon with pagoda silhouette in the distance, swirling colorful pink teal and blue nebula clouds and floating lanterns fill the dark sky, whimsical fantasy scene, atmospheric lighting
